Demonstrates a potential AI workload beyond HBM capacity, but this is a technical proof of concept, not a disclosed commercial order.
144 SSDs provide approximately 1.1 PB raw capacity
Shows the scale of the tested configuration; the release provides no revenue, customer commitment, or commercialization timeline.
Kioxia and NVIDIA are evaluating technical feasibility
Further validation is needed before the approach can be treated as a deployable commercial product.

This is an early-stage technical demonstration of Kioxia SSDs for AI data processing, rather than a commercial deployment. A larger catalyst would require further performance validation and evidence of customer adoption or revenue impact.
